findings.label: Audio tests conditionally skipped due to missing FFmpeg/FFprobe in PATH
findings.description: The test environment does not have FFmpeg and FFprobe binaries in the system PATH, so test_audio_is_decoded_and_measured_without_changing_original and test_real_audio_feature_extraction_with_librosa skip locally. These tests execute in CI (apt installs ffmpeg) and should run once ffmpeg/ffprobe are available locally. Check logs in CI to confirm they execute there (they should).

findings.label: Video rendering tests skip due to FFmpeg build capabilities
findings.description: test_ffmpeg_renders_valid_private_mp4[music_visualizer] and test_ffmpeg_renders_valid_private_mp4[full_music_video] skip because FFmpeg lacks drawtext filter or h264/aac codecs. This is a legitimate platform constraint. The tests skip gracefully with diagnostic output, not fail. Attempting to force these tests to run without the required codec support would introduce environment-specific flakiness.

findings.label: Scheduler tests use mocked audio functions
findings.description: The five scheduler integration tests mock verify_audio and extract_features to focus verification on scheduler behavior (job discovery, atomic dispatch, stale-job requeuing, bounded retries) rather than audio processing. This is appropriate and intentional; the end-to-end tests cover the real audio pipeline. Real audio tests (test_audio.py) are separate and conditional on FFmpeg availability.
